tool_input.notes: This is the Human Rights Commission landing page. Only one line describes a rental-housing rule: the Fair Chance Ordinance, which protects people with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions. The page gives no section citation, dates, or specific limits. Everything else on the page is events, reports, and general anti-discrimination content, so none of it was recorded.
